body: ordered a vial on the 7th of october, arrived on the 21st. very pleased with the order and the shipping time! the vial came with a discreet label in a tiny white box. the liquid inside is crystal clear.

The order was processed in 3 days, and shipping took an additional 8 days (around 1.5 weeks total from Germany to Poland). The tracking didn’t update for 4 days, which had me pretty worried, but it arrived safely! Packaging was discreet and protected the vial well enough during transit. The vial itself looks great—the solution is completely clear with zero particles
Received very quickly, looks clear, very safe packaging for minimal damage risk ^^
Received my vials super quickly! 7 days to be exact :D
